title: Lifecycle invariants A2/A6/A9 could name the new unknown-question symbols in their `today` lists
body: The pinned contracts/lifecycle-invariants.json A2/A6/A9 `today` entries for cloud/factory/src/run-workflow.ts still describe the old `.catch(() => null)` behaviour this tick replaced. A bundle re-cut could add the new symbols (ObservedProcessState, PROCESS_QUERY_ATTEMPTS, MAX_UNANSWERED_LOOKS, orchestratorUnanswerableFeedEvent, STAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_UNANSWERABLE) so the cross-reference checks pin the new distinction the same way they pin the old one. The bundle is pinned, so this is a ticks-repo contract change, not an edit here.
